# JSON stringify

Turn JSON into an escaped string (stringify) and back (parse).

Category: Encoders · ID: `json-string` · Search terms: stringify, parse, escape, unescape, embed, quote, json

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui json-string [encode|decode] [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. JSON or JSON string

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--mode` | `encode`, `decode` | `encode` | Mode. encode = stringify, decode = parse |
| `--compact` | on/off | `true` | Compact. encode: drop the whitespace of the JSON first |
| `--quotes` | on/off | `true` | Quotes. encode: wrap the string in quotes |
| `--indent` | 0–8 | `2` | Indent. decode: spaces per level of the JSON; 0 = compact |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/json-string`), so they are what the tool prints.

### nested-parse

Input:

```text
"\"{\\\"user\\\":\\\"ana\\\",\\\"roles\\\":[\\\"admin\\\",\\\"dev\\\"]}\""
```

Output:

```text
{
  "user": "ana",
  "roles": [
    "admin",
    "dev"
  ]
}
```

### order-stringify

Input:

```text
{
  "id": 1024,
  "customer": "Ana \"La Jefa\" Pérez",
  "items": [{"sku": "A-1", "qty": 2}],
  "note": "line one\nline two",
  "html": "<b>&</b>"
}
```

Output:

```text
"{\"id\":1024,\"customer\":\"Ana \\\"La Jefa\\\" Pérez\",\"items\":[{\"sku\":\"A-1\",\"qty\":2}],\"note\":\"line one\\nline two\",\"html\":\"<b>&</b>\"}"
```

### order-stringify-spaced

Input:

```text
{
  "id": 1024,
  "customer": "Ana \"La Jefa\" Pérez",
  "items": [{"sku": "A-1", "qty": 2}],
  "note": "line one\nline two",
  "html": "<b>&</b>"
}
```

Output:

```text
"{\n  \"id\": 1024,\n  \"customer\": \"Ana \\\"La Jefa\\\" Pérez\",\n  \"items\": [{\"sku\": \"A-1\", \"qty\": 2}],\n  \"note\": \"line one\\nline two\",\n  \"html\": \"<b>&</b>\"\n}"
```
